faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions about event tracking with OpenPanel.

items.question: Do I need cookies for event tracking?
items.answer: No. OpenPanel can run without cookies. We use a first-party cookie only if you enable it for better session continuity. Many teams run fully cookie-less and still get accurate funnels and retention.

items.question: How is this different from Google Analytics?
items.answer: Google Analytics is built for marketing and traffic analysis, with a complex data model. OpenPanel is built for product and conversion: simple events that map directly to user actions. You get funnels, retention, and user profiles without the GA learning curve.

items.question: Can I track custom events?
items.answer: Yes. You can send any event name and attach optional properties (e.g. plan, value, feature_name). Custom events work in funnels, retention, and user profiles the same way as built-in events.
